NOT NULL), unique_appearances AS (SELECT DISTINCT match_id,player_id,outcome FROM appearances), counts AS (SELECT player_id,outcome,COUNT(*) matches FROM unique_appearances GROUP BY player_id,outcome) SELECT c.outcome,p.player_name,c.matches FROM counts c JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id=c.player_id WHERE c.matches=(SELECT MAX(x.matches) FROM counts x WHERE x.outcome=c.outcome) ORDER BY c.outcome,p.player_name
